Regenerate from the TORCS runtime directory, in this order:
trackgen.exe -c test -n multi-cross-7 -z
trackgen.exe -c test -n multi-cross-7 -a -q
trackgen.exe -c test -n multi-cross-7 -r
accc.exe -g tracks/test/multi-cross-7/multi-cross-7.acc -l0 tracks/test/multi-cross-7/multi-cross-7.ac -l1 tracks/test/multi-cross-7/multi-cross-7-trk-raceline.ac -d3 1000 -d2 500 -d1 300 -S 300 -es
